issuer: the driving licence authority (Fahrerlaubnisbehörde) of the holder's district or city
note: Read 2026-10-30 on gesetze-im-internet.de: the Fahrerlaubnis-Verordnung, § 10, gives the youngest age for class B as 18 (17 in accompanied driving, not held), and § 24a says licences issued from 19 January 2013 are valid for 15 years; the Gebührenordnung für Maßnahmen im Straßenverkehr, item 202.1, gives first grant of a driving licence at €35.70. That is the authority's fee; the card's production, the driving test (TÜV or DEKRA) and the driving school aren't held. The national identity card (Personalausweis) is a different office's and isn't held here. The exchange list is FeV Anlage 11 (read 2026-10-30): the states, territories, US states, Canadian provinces and Australian states and territories whose car licence (class B or its equivalent) it lists with no theory test and no practical test ('nein', 'nein'); those it lists with a theory test (Connecticut, the District of Columbia, Florida, Indiana, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, North Carolina, Oregon, Tennessee) or a practical one (Moldova) are left out, as are its notes on individual classes, eyesight proof and learner licences. Licences of the EU and EEA states are recognised under § 29 without any exchange and aren't on the list, so they aren't held here.

sources.title: Fahrerlaubnis-Verordnung (FeV), § 24a Gültigkeit von Führerscheinen
sources.said: Die Gültigkeit der ab dem 19. Januar 2013 ausgestellten Führerscheine ist auf 15 Jahre befristet.
